recipe.name: Cheese Breadsticks
directions: Preheat: Place your Baking Steel on the top rack and heat the oven to 450°F for 45 minutes. The hot steel gives you a perfectly crisp crust.
Shape the dough: Divide the dough into 100 g balls. On lightly floured parchment, flatten each ball into a 6-inch oval to remove large air bubbles.
Add cheese: Place a mozzarella stick in the center of each piece of dough.
Roll and seal: Roll the dough over the cheese like a cigar. Pinch the seam and ends closed, then set seam-side down on the parchment.
Bake: Launch onto your hot Baking Steel and bake for 10–12 minutes, until golden brown and crisp. For extra color, finish under the broiler for 30 seconds.
Serve: Let cool briefly, then serve with warm tomato sauce for dipping.

ingredients.name: Cheese
ingredients.notes: mozzarella string cheese or any melting cheese
